itens.trecho: Magnífico. Vi este filme pela primeira vez há uns bons anos atrás, mas só agora resolvi falar sobre ele, após o ter visto novamente. Para mim, é um dos melhores filmes italianos já feitos. É como se fosse um conto de fadas moderno, que nos mostra o lado fascinante do cinema, e que nos leva a recordar porque é que gostamos dele.

Magnificent. I saw this movie for the first time a good few years ago, but I only decided to talk about it now, after seeing it again. For me, it is one of the best Italian films ever made. It's like a modern fairy tale, showing us the fascinating side of cinema and reminding us why we love it.

When you think about cinematography, nowadays you usually think about digital cinematography. But during the early '50s, '60s, and onward, there was a use of this thing called film. Film was what they used in cameras before cameras actually saved them into memory slots digitally.
